        More help for families
          Words used on this page
          GT
          Short for gifted and talented. A student the school system has identified as having outstanding talent, or the potential for it, compared with others of a similar age and experience.
          Universal screening
          Looking at every student in a grade, not only those a teacher or parent nominates, to find who may need GT services.
          CogAT
          The Cognitive Abilities Test, a group reasoning test that many Maryland school systems use as one part of GT screening.
          ESSA plan
          The Every Student Succeeds Act plan. Each school system writes a Consolidated Strategic Plan that should describe how it serves GT students.
          IEP and 504 plan
          Written plans that give extra support to students with disabilities. A student can be gifted and have one of these plans, which is sometimes called twice exceptional or 2e.
          Acceleration
          Moving a student ahead in one subject or a whole grade because they are ready, instead of keeping to the usual pace for their age.
